run_analyze_results_cli: run the analyze_results CLI to evaluate detection results and save good vs bad sample images
evaluate_bbox_map: evaluate the mean average precision of single image detection results across multiple IoU thresholds
visualize_detection_results: visualize and save object detection predictions alongside ground truths using ResultVisualizer
evaluate_panoptic_segmentation: evaluate panoptic segmentation results and identify top and bottom performing samples by PQ score
save_good_bad_samples: save the best and worst detection or segmentation samples to separate directories for analysis
